title: Sensitivity Analysis JSON Schema

items.description: List of sensitivity analysis items. Each item represents one or more parameters that will be varied.

changes.description: List of changes associated with this sensitivity analysis item.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter (theta) or equation to be varied.

up.description: Value used for the 'up' direction. Multiplier if up_down_as_factor is true, absolute value otherwise.

down.description: Value used for the 'down' direction. Divider if up_down_as_factor is true, absolute value otherwise.

up_down_as_factor.description: If true (default), up and down values are treated as factor/multiplier/divider. If false, they are treated as absolute values.

where.description: Where to apply the change: 'theta' for model parameters or 'equation' for model code/equations.

log.description: Only used when where='theta'. If true, specifies that the theta is in log scale and the change should be applied in linear scale then back-transformed.
